summary: On OpenShift each AAP component is a pod whose requests and limits are set in the AAP CR; defaults are minimum requests with no limits, so pods can use spare node resources. Growth runs on a dedicated SNO; controller task pod capacity, and thus concurrent jobs, comes from the node. Hub uses S3 storage because OpenShift storage differs from VMs.
questions: Does the AAP Operator set resource limits on pods by default?
How is controller capacity calculated on OpenShift?
Why does the Operator growth topology use S3 for automation hub?
